description: Reddit Keyword Filter (Hide keyword content: hides Reddit posts and comments by keyword, community, account, flair, post type, score, and number of comments; also Navigation and sidebar, Media options, Morphe branding, Say subreddits, and Fix search media taps) and YouTube Extras (channel-scoped filters, video length, topic, and category filters, automatic Not interested and likes, and fixes). Select it together with Morphe Patches; the settings are in Settings > Morphe.

patches.name: YouTube Extras
patches.description: Adds channel filters, video length, category, and topic filters, playlists on Home, live chat on all messages, and the other options of Settings > Morphe > YouTube Extras.

patches.name: Fix search media taps
patches.description: Opens the tapped post from a search's Media tab. Reddit opens the post next to it after an account is blocked, or when the viewer leaves out a hidden, removed, or promoted post listed before it.

patches.name: Hide keyword content
patches.description: Hides posts and comments by keyword, subreddit, author, flair, type, score, and number of comments. Select it together with Morphe Patches' Reddit patches, whose settings screen (Settings > Morphe) gets the Keyword filter sections.

patches.name: Media options
patches.description: Adds switches in Settings > Morphe, off until turned on, to turn captions on by default, open older posts' media links in a player, and show media Reddit marks with a caution without the blur.

patches.name: Morphe branding
patches.description: Adds switches, off until turned on in Settings > Morphe, for the Morphe logo in place of Reddit's Snoo, Morphe's loading animation in place of Reddit's, and the Morphe launcher icon.

patches.name: Navigation and sidebar
patches.description: Adds switches in Settings > Morphe, off until turned on, to hide the Inbox button, sidebar rows, and the sidebar button's badge, and to keep the top and bottom bars shown while a feed scrolls.

patches.name: Say subreddits
patches.description: Adds a switch, off until turned on in Settings > Morphe, which renames communities to subreddits throughout Reddit's own text, in English and Spanish, and in the keyword filter's settings.

release_notes:
- Reddit: opening a post no longer shows "Oops, we have encountered an error" when a filter rule matches it. The filters now leave the post being opened alone.
- Reddit: the credit (Made by Bryce Springfield, and the GitHub source) moved from the Other page to a Reddit Keyword Filter section in Morphe's About dialog.

Tested with Morphe Patches v2.1.0 on Reddit 2026.45.0 and 2026.44.0 and YouTube 21.44.528.
repoDescription: Morphe patch bundles, one folder an app: Reddit Keyword Filter and YouTube Extras
